# Dental Office Manager — Bright Smiles Clinic

**Location:** Remote (EU) · **Type:** Full-time

Bright Smiles is a growing network of dental practices. We are hiring an experienced office manager to
run scheduling, insurance billing, patient intake, and front-desk staff across three clinics.

## Responsibilities

- Manage appointment scheduling and patient communications
- Oversee insurance claims and billing reconciliation
- Supervise and roster front-desk staff

## Requirements

- 5+ years healthcare administration or dental office management
- Familiarity with dental practice-management software

Expected triage: **rejected** — no overlap with AI Engineering or Test Automation directions.
